answer: An adversary as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The willow counter is kept in quartz and basalt shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3086 identities would post 1484 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
